gaps.original_claim: Guide names acquisition ethical dilemmas but offers no worked application.
gaps.proposal: Add a compact exercise: an OPNAV colleague requests an off-record analysis of a 30% RDT&E cut and forbids informing the PM. Identify facts/authority, stakeholder duties and risks, develop authorized alternatives, consult leadership/ethics channels, make and monitor a principled choice. Mark as suggested analysis, not a coursebook answer key.
